contracts: missions/<f>/plan.json and approved.json (merged): the mission plan, its milestones, and agents
delivery/<f>/events.jsonl: one append-only record of every build event of a Feature, and one progress comment (#1010); paging reads it (#1011)

aayu ship inside an approved mission merges on proof and holds only a PR the person marked review, an undeclared high-risk diff, an authority change, or a failed floor (#1030, Decision #1027 option 2)
the story subthread brief names the 10-step build loop, including the local gate and a subagent review before each push, and an eval fails when a step is missing (#1104)
the feedback pass at mission end turns comments into stories (#1014); aayu install --loops adds the local wake loop (#1126); the lock ends at the last gate (#1134)
v0.4.1: red runs in proof packs (#1109), real-run journeys (#1110), function beyond the ask (#1111), milestone findings order the next milestone (#1112)
rollback: Ledger files are append-only or versioned; a revert stops new writes and leaves records readable. A revert of #1030 returns ship to today's rule: the narrow set and plan-time reviews need a person per PR. A revert of #1126 leaves wake loops that do nothing until aayu install --loops runs again.
